We partner with international brands to expand their presence in the hospitality, leisure, and entertainment sectors. Iconic names like Nikki Beach and Manero have entrusted us to establish and grow their venues in Spain’s top tourist destinations.

Don Carlos Marbella, part of the Selenta Group portfolio, is an iconic Costa del Sol resort, fully refurbished in 2025, combining premium accommodation with seven dining concepts, a 1,600 m² spa, over 20,000 m² of landscaped gardens and 17 meeting and event spaces. Its offering is further enhanced through strategic partnerships with Rafa Nadal Tennis Center, Manero, Algrano, Lucia and Nikki Beach, reinforcing its position as a benchmark in the luxury hospitality segment.

Moxy Barcelona, part of the Selenta Group portfolio, is a lifestyle hotel located next to Barcelona Sants, a strategic location for both leisure and business travellers. It combines contemporary design, functional rooms, event spaces and a swimming pool with panoramic views. Its offering is complemented by Bonavista Rooftop, developed in collaboration with Grupo Confitería, a partnership that further strengthens the hotel's positioning in the city.

Manero Marbella is a unique cocktail experience that blends the Italian sophistication of the aperitivo with the warmth and vibrancy of Spanish culture. This innovative concept is born from the collaboration between iconic Italian brand CAMPARI and renowned Spanish restaurant group MANERO.
